Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 Details Reveal Six New Maps, New Weapons, and DMZ Expansion

Activision has officially detailed the upcoming content for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Season 1, outlining a significant update that includes new multiplayer maps, weaponry, modes, and an expansion to the game's DMZ extraction mode.

Following the recent release of Shipment, Season 1 is scheduled to launch with an initial wave of three maps on November 6. The upcoming locations introduce varied environmental designs, including a snowy village map called Backstab and a desert-themed map named Canyon. Additionally, the fan-favorite map Shoot House is returning, reimagined within a Korean setting while preserving its traditional layout and tight sightlines first introduced in the 2019 title. Three additional maps are slated for release later in the season.

New Weapons, Attachments, and DMZ Content

Season 1 brings a suite of new firearms and equipment, featuring a tomahawk and weapons drawing design inspiration from classic titles, such as the FMG9 and AA-12. A weapon designated as the Cronen Osprey also appears to reference the CX9 from Modern Warfare (2019) and the Scorpion Evo from Black Ops 2. Players will also gain access to new attachments, including a burst-fire mod for the M4 that converts the weapon into an M16.

For players focused on the extraction-based DMZ mode, Activision confirmed the addition of a new area named X01. Described as a dimly lit, enclosed subterranean labyrinth of tunnels and passageways, the zone is designed to offer high-tier loot alongside significant combat threats, new bosses, FOB upgrades, and specialized loot objectives.

Returning Modes and Aesthetic Direction

Classic multiplayer modes—including Infection, Grind, and Drop Zone—are confirmed to return during Season 1 alongside a standard battle pass featuring cosmetic unlocks and character skins. According to the announcement, the initial seasonal lineup maintains a grounded visual aesthetic, aligning with previous developer statements regarding the exclusion of over-the-top crossover skins.

Practical Implications and Verification

What Is Confirmed

  • Six total new maps arriving across the season, with three launching on November 6.
  • The return of Shoot House with a Korean aesthetic, alongside Backstab and Canyon.
  • Addition of new weapons, a tomahawk, and weapon attachments like the M4 burst mod.
  • The introduction of the X01 DMZ area, complete with new bosses, FOB upgrades, and loot.
  • The return of classic modes like Infection, Grind, and Drop Zone.

What Remains Unknown

  • Specific release dates for the three maps scheduled to drop later in the season.
  • Exact statistical changes or balancing details for the newly introduced weapons and attachments.
